190c0debc752d0c2299a339cfa584b1b5c84a052: A resort on a human scale, Gérardmer prides itself on the quality of its welcome and its closeness rather than on impressive figures. Its 40 km of runs are ideal for a stay of 3 to 4 days, especially for families or skiers who don't need to constantly change their playground. Gérardmer's family reputation is well deserved: dedicated beginner areas, a well-run childcare service, well-groomed green runs and a friendly atmosphere at the foot of the lifts. It is one of the most reassuring resorts in the Vosges for laying the foundations of skiing with children. Gérardmer's modest altitude, from 750 m at the village to 1140 m at the summit, makes it sensitive to changes in the weather. January and February remain the safest months for optimal snow cover. Outside this window, checking the snow reports before you travel is strongly advised. At 36€, the day lift pass places Gérardmer in the mid-range category for cost: neither cheap nor exorbitant. The quality of the ski area and its facilities justifies this price for most skiers. In short, Gérardmer is one of those rare resorts that combines a real village, a sincerely family-friendly atmosphere and runs suited to everyone. It's hard to have a bad stay here.
